results.title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
results.original_title: Heart of Light: Eleven Songs for Fiji
results.overview: After decades abroad, Iona returns to her childhood home on Fiji, sensing that there she might find the answers to many questions she has about civilisation and its discontent.

results.title: Watermelon
results.overview: "Sun" sets out to visit "Phlu", who lives in an old apartment building in the middle of the city. When he arrives, he discovers that the building has no running water. He has no choice but to track down six tenants to collect their signatures, as required by the landlord, before the water supply can be restored.  Along the way, "Sun"learns about the struggles of each tenant, all of whom are fighting to get by in a system that keeps pushing them down. As their stories unfold, he begins to see how people are forced to compromise their dignity and moral values just to survive.

results.title: The Wolf, the Fox, and the Leopard
results.original_title: The Wolf, the Fox, and the Leopard
results.overview: When a girl raised by wolves is found in the woods, she is subjected to a series of tests and examinations in a lab. After two environmentalists free her because they see her as a potential saviour of the world, she must learn to stand on her own two feet and make her own choices

results.title: Never Seen
results.overview: Two friends enter an abandoned house looking for vintage tech and discover something inside that has been waiting for them.

results.title: A Bit of Light
results.overview: After being arrested and having his medical practice shut down, an Iranian doctor loses faith in the future and resolves to end his life - but one final day among his family begins to unsettle his decision.

results.title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 2
results.original_title: NJPW Road to G1 Climax 36 - Day 2
results.overview: The second night of Road to G1 Climax 36 was a professional wrestling event promoted by New Japan Pro Wrestling (NJPW) that took place on June 21, 2026, at Sagamihara City Gymnasium in Sagamihara, Kanagawa, Japan.

results.title: I Swiped the Wrong One
results.overview: A typical rom-com with an atypical rom-com ending, I Swiped the Wrong One is the story of four thirtysomethings who attempt to navigate the world of 21st century online dating.

results.title: Give Me the Ball!
results.overview: World champion tennis trailblazer Billie Jean King has had a game-changing impact on culture and sports. Rare archive and candid interviews with Billie Jean and those closest to her reveal how one woman put changing the world ahead of saving herself.

results.title: Caterpillar
results.overview: Three generations living under one leaky Wellington roof in 2003, all on the brink of transformation. Sixteen-year-old Cassie is all bravado and vulnerability, drifting into risky territory as she searches for validation in all the wrong places. Her mother Maxine, 52, a formidable single-mother filmmaker on the brink of a long-awaited breakthrough, is finally offered a greenlight - if she can just land a star. Holding everything together is Huia, Cassie’s grandmother, 80, whose life has been defined by quiet service to family and a private obsession with raising monarch caterpillars, dreaming of one day witnessing the legendary butterfly migration in Mexico. But when Huia’s mind begins to fail her, the family is thrust into chaos. Can the maternal line hold together while everything is throwing them apart?

results.title: Atlas King
results.overview: Ex-fighter returns from exile to bury his best friend and confront old rivalries. Reuniting with his godson, a streetwise enforcer entangled with a powerful crime syndicate, the two hatch a high-stakes heist in a desperate bid to escape the grip of a ruthless mob bos

results.title: in the sentimental lugo
results.overview: A Galician living in La Plata returns to Lugo with his daughter after 27 years, against all odds

results.title: The Orphan
results.overview: When a vulnerable teenager seeking belonging is groomed by a dangerous street figure, he’s pulled into the violent world of County Lines, and must confront a past that refuses to stay buried. A gripping, raw and emotional drama, about loss, loyalty and the making of a young life on the edge.

results.title: The Way We Move
results.overview: Amber Galloway, a trailblazer in ASL interpretation, takes us on a journey into the deep bond between the Deaf world and music. We follow her as she teaches struggling recruits who she hopes will have what it takes to join her at ACL music festival.

results.title: Krakatoa
results.overview: A Javanese fisherman experiences the greatest volcanic eruption of all time. Stranded on a deserted island, in search of food and water, he draws closer to the depths of the earth. A visceral and psychedelic odyssey.

results.title: Aversion
results.overview: Follows a group of students as they overcome their phobias to survive.

results.title: Guerrilla Filmmaker
results.overview: A documentary about ultra-low budget guerrilla filmmaking, deep in the heart of Texas.

results.title: Kitti
results.overview: A psychological thriller that explores the fragile boundaries between reality, fear, and the human mind. When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

results.title: Rise and Shine
results.overview: Terri Steele has waited her whole life for high school. She wants what every teenager wants: new friends, a beautiful dress, a date to prom and the chance to be seen for exactly who she is. Her mother, Janice, has spent Terri’s whole life helping her believe the world can make room for her. Now they must discover what it means to let go, grow up and step into a new day.

results.title: Find Fenia
results.overview: Fenia disappears, and Niki loses her best friend. Through an imagined journey of search and discovery, Niki tries to understand what has happened. The scenarios she constructs in her mind spiral out of control, yet the answer is probably far simpler than she imagines.
